question: Under what condition is even a wise person said to be burning, with reference to nectar and juice?
premises: Reference is made to the tip of nectar.
Reference is made to the tip of juice as a means.
Even a wise person, while burning, is in view under that condition.
inference: Even the wise undergo burning in relation to the tip of nectar taken by means of the tip of juice.
uncertainties: The technical process intended is not fully explained by this verse alone.
plain_english: At the tip of nectar, with the tip of juice, even the wise person, while burning, does so also.
